title: Words of Devotion
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: After high school, best friends Tachibana and Otani move in together as a secret couple. When they run into a former classmate, Yuki, with whom Tachibana was once close, Otani's insecurity grows and old rumours resurface. The two-volume collection also includes linked stories, such as one about a soccer team's captain and vice-captain.
life_message: Love needs words spoken aloud; unsaid feelings breed doubt.
